items: Rents increase by 2.0% annually per Invest Detroit's credit guidelines.
7% residential vacancy rate based on borrower's projections.

Blended stabilized vacancy of 7.0% (weighted by gross rent) is below Invest Detroit's 15% commercial vacancy guideline and at or above the appraiser's 6% estimate. The guideline applies to commercial space; residential vacancy is the borrower's assumption.
55.0% total vacancy in 2026 based on borrower's projections and anticipated time for leasing activities.
Expenses increase by at least 3% annually per Invest Detroit's credit guidelines.
Based on appraiser's estimate ($52,000). Borrower projected $48,000 of real estate taxes.
Leasing & Marketing is a one-time lease-up cost; excluded after the first year.
Replacement reserves increased by $3,800 to Invest Detroit's guideline of $0.50/SF ($11,000 on 22,000 SF, net of capital reserves).

Terms estimated by underwriter (Perm Mtg $2,300,000 @ 7.50%, 30-year amortization). Loan amount was based on 1.25x DSC on 2028 NOI of $207,396 (maximum $1,977,417); under this scenario the LTC would be 47.8%. Only 6 months of debt service was estimated in 2027.
Sensitized case assumes the loans are not refinanced by a take-out lender and the proposed construction loan remains.
Residential vacancy was adjusted to get to 1.00x DSC. Residential vacancy can increase to 0.1% to 1.4% in the stabilized years for DSC to be 1.00x (projected: 7.0%).
The sensitized case shows limited cushion on the proposed construction loan (-6.9 points of additional residential vacancy before DSC reaches 1.00x).
Break-even occupancy on the base case is 89.6% of gross potential rent in 2028.
